ic_name: JESD204 Serial Interface for Data Converters (JESD204B/C)

test_modes.name: CGS / sync-pattern test
test_modes.purpose: Verify /K28.5/ comma alignment and the SYNC~ handshake.

test_modes.name: ILAS verification
test_modes.purpose: Check the four-multiframe ILAS content and the FCHK checksum.

test_modes.name: Error-injection
test_modes.purpose: Inject disparity / invalid code / misalignment and confirm detection and SYNC~ re-assertion.

test_modes.name: Deterministic-latency test
test_modes.purpose: Verify repeatable latency across power cycles in Subclass 1/2.

spec_provided_observability.name: SYNC~ error reporting
spec_provided_observability.purpose: JESD204B receivers can re-assert SYNC~ (with defined timing) to report link errors and force re-synchronization.

spec_provided_observability.name: ILAS configuration checksum (FCHK)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: The receiver verifies the in-band link configuration against its own; a checksum mismatch flags a misconfigured link.

spec_provided_observability.name: 8b/10b error monitoring
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Disparity errors, not-in-table (invalid code) errors, and unexpected control characters are detected and counted (204B).

spec_provided_observability.name: Command channel / CRC / FEC status (204C)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: In JESD204C the command channel and CRC/FEC report payload integrity and status in-band.

spec_provided_observability.name: Alignment monitoring
spec_provided_observability.purpose: /A/ (multiframe) and /F/ (frame) characters allow continuous lane/frame alignment checking and realignment (204B).

error_detection_mechanisms: Unexpected control character errors (a /K/A/F/ out of place).
JESD204C: CRC and optional Reed-Solomon FEC on the payload.
notes: JESD204's protocol-level observability is the SYNC~ error-reporting path, the ILAS FCHK checksum, the 8b/10b error monitors (204B), and the command channel / CRC / FEC status (204C). Chip-level JTAG/scan/BIST remain device-integrator concerns.
